title: Deep learning stroma-immune score predicts survival in stage II-III colorectal cancer
summary: A convolutional neural network classified tissue on CD3 and CD8 immunohistochemistry whole-slide images, and a stroma-immune score was built from T-cell density in the stroma. Higher scores were associated with longer survival in development (N = 200), internal validation (N = 134) and external validation (N = 90) groups; in the development group, 5-year survival was 55.7% versus 80.8% for low versus high scores. The cohorts are modest and retrospective.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network for tissue classification on CD3/CD8 IHC whole-slide images
organization: Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital; South China University of Technology

evidence.tested: Internal validation (N = 134) and external validation from a second cohort (N = 90).
evidence.unknown: Prognostic value beyond standard staging in prospective use; the abstract's survival results were partly truncated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Quantifies CD3+ and CD8+ T-cell infiltration in the stroma region.
